an4.49:1.3: anicce bhikkhave niccanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:1.4: dukkhe bhikkhave sukhanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:1.5: anattani bhikkhave attāti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:1.6: asubhe bhikkhave subhanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:1.7: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro saññāvipallāsā cittavipallāsā diṭṭhivipallāsā.
an4.49:2.1: cattāro’me bhikkhave na saññāvipallāsā na cittavipallāsā na diṭṭhivipallāsā.
an4.49:2.3: anicce bhikkhave aniccanti na saññāvipallāso na cittavipallāso na diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:2.4: dukkhe bhikkhave dukkhanti na saññāvipallāso na cittavipallāso na diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:2.5: anattani bhikkhave anattāti na saññāvipallāso na cittavipallāso na diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:2.6: asubhe bhikkhave asubhanti na saññāvipallāso na cittavipallāso na diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:2.7: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro na saññāvipallāsā na cittavipallāsā na diṭṭhivipallāsāti.
